phase: Phase 5D — Wildfire / Vegetation-Burn Data Acquisition & Cross-Domain Validation

geographic_leakage_audit.description: All GAS_FLARE observations originate from Gujarat, India (lat ~22.3N, lon ~69.8E). All WILDFIRE observations originate from the US Pacific Northwest (lat 43-48N, lon -121 to -122W). A decision tree given latitude/longitude or facility identifiers will memorize geography with 100% accuracy rather than learning thermal source characteristics.

supervised_model_readiness_test.scientific_justification: Although 1,282 Tier-1 wildfire observations were successfully matched, they derive from only TWO physical wildfire events on a single calendar day (2022-09-11) in a single ecosystem (Cascades conifer forest). Evaluating or training on only 2 physical wildfire events is mathematically degenerate and risks severe event-level overfitting. Additional physical wildfire events across diverse fire regimes (e.g. California chaparral, Great Plains grasslands, Texas rangelands) must be acquired before training is defensible.
